verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents escalation policies that automate incident assignment to users and schedules, notifying one target at a time until someone acknowledges, and incidents escalate according to the service's policy. Community users corroborate fallback escalation tiers and time-based escalation when no ack arrives. missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable per-step escalation delays/timeouts, explicit evidence of repeat-round (loop) settings.
